author: IlayM
quote:
There’s not even any point in going into detail here. Just imagine GTA V, with its story and narrative, but with today’s level of graphics, destruction physics, attention to detail, and so on. Now compare that image in your head to this game. This is what happens when you let people whose creative talents barely extend beyond writing gay Harry Potter and Draco Malfoy fanfiction develop the most expensive game in history. This is ridiculous. 
When is this madness finally going to end...
